REPORT_ENGINE: Kitten hiding in a car engine
REPORT_CONSTRUCTION: Injured cat on a building site

REPORT_PARK: Stray cat by the park benches

ADOPT_GRANDMA_DESC: Lives alone in a flat. Looking for a calm companion for the sofa.
ADOPT_FAMILY_KIDS_DESC: A house with a garden and two kids who can’t wait. They want a playful kitten.
ADOPT_FARMER_DESC: Has a dog and hens on the farm. Looking for an independent cat that doesn’t scare easily.
ADOPT_STUDENT_DESC: Small flat, lots of lectures. Needs a cat that doesn’t mind some time alone.
ADOPT_HOMEWORKER_DESC: Works from home in a quiet flat, no kids. Would love a cat on his lap.
ADOPT_YOUNG_COUPLE_DESC: Their first flat together and busy lives. Dreaming of a kitten.
ADOPT_RETIRED_VET_DESC: Spent her life caring for animals. Has a garden and is happy to take an older cat.
ADOPT_DOG_OWNER_DESC: A house with a garden and a big friendly dog. Looking for a brave cat.
UI_NO_REPORTS: No reports yet. A new one will come soon.
UI_NO_CAGE: No free cage. Heal a cat, then rehome or keep it.
UI_READY_HINT: Healthy and trusting. Wait for an adopter, or keep her.
UI_RESIDENT_HINT: Lives in the corner and attracts visitors who leave donations.
UI_MATCH_UNCERTAIN: estimate only – you don’t know her whole personality
UI_POOR_WARNING: I’m not sure they’re a good fit…
POSTCARD_PERFECT: {cat} is completely happy with us. Thank you for bringing us together!
POSTCARD_GOOD: {cat} has settled in and slept on the bed for the first time today. Thank you!
UI_NO_POSTCARDS: Postcards arrive a few minutes after an adoption.
UI_WELCOME_NOTHING: The cats were waiting for you.
MG_TICK_HINT: Grab a tick and pull it away slowly. Too fast and it slips!
MG_FEATHER_HINT: Wiggle the feather – not too fast, not too slow.
MG_HOLD_HINT: Hold your finger on the cat until the ring fills.
MG_QUIET_HINT: Don’t do anything. Just be there.
UI_TRAITS_HINT: You learn her personality through care – by what she enjoys and what she doesn’t.
CH_SHY: Find a home for a shy cat
TUT_REPORT: Hi, I’m Zuzka! A cat report came in – tap 📋 and take the cat in.
TUT_EXAMINE: First a check-up: in the Health tab use ✋ and 🌡️ to find out what’s wrong.
TUT_TREAT: Now treat everything we found – tap Treat.
TUT_CARE: She’s healthier but doesn’t trust us yet. Win her trust in the Care tab.
TUT_READY: She’s ready! Wait for a visitor 🚪, or keep her as a resident.
TUT_MENU: Great job! The ☰ menu has challenges, the album and garage upgrades.
UI_CHALLENGES_HINT: Challenges have no time limit. A new one comes after you claim the reward.
UI_ALBUM_HINT: Every cat you rehome or keep is recorded by breed and coat.
UI_NEW_GAME_CONFIRM: Really start over? Your saved game will be deleted.
TOAST_CHALLENGE: Challenge complete! Claim the reward in ☰
MG_BANDAGE_HINT: Circle your finger around the paw – wrap it three times. Stay close to the bandage.
MG_EAR_HINT: Wipe all the dirt from the ears with your finger.
MG_SYRUP_HINT: Tap when the marker is in the green zone. Three spoonfuls.
MG_BREATH_HINT: Hold your finger while the circle grows (breathe in). Let go while it shrinks (breathe out).
UI_CAFE_DESC: Resident cats move into the café: +{slots} spots, guests who leave donations and double passive donations.
UI_CAFE_NO_RESIDENTS: Guests come once at least one resident cat lives here. Keep a recovered cat as a resident.
UI_CAFE_NO_GUESTS: No guests yet – someone will drop by soon. Tap the bubble above a guest or Serve.
TOAST_CAFE_OPEN: The café is open! Resident cats moved in ☕
TOAST_GUEST: A guest came to the café ☕
